items.title: Howard Johnson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2019
items.q: when we did, the last thing he did with the orchestra in Montreux with the Gil Evans arrangements and Quincy Jones conducting

ctx.x: He said that once it’s recorded he doesn’t want to hear it anymore because that’s going back. He doesn’t want to go back. He only wants to go forward. As a result, when we did, the last thing he did with the orchestra in Montreux with the Gil Evans arrangements and Quincy Jones conducting, when he was doing that, Gil Goldstein had sent him the parts in March or something like that, for this concert in the summer. He hadn’t cracked those parts open and he wasn’t ready with the chops or the concept when the concert…
